﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: dropwizard-client 2.1.5 -> 4.0.0

## Context

Project `lithium` (by wireapp) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`io.dropwizard:dropwizard-client` from `2.1.5` to `4.0.0` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/wireapp/lithium/pull/98

## Your Task

The source code is in `/lithium`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the project structure and identifying the compilation errors.

arguments.description: Run maven compile to see errors

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
    <artifactId>lithium</artifactId>
    <version>3.5.1</version>
    <name>Lithium</name>
    <description>Wire Bots SDK written in Java</description>
    <url>https://wire.com/</url>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>GNU General Public License v3.0</name>
            <url>https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>

    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>Dejan Kovacevic</name>
            <email>dejan@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
        <developer>
            <name>Lukas Forst</name>
            <email>lukas@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
    </developers>

    <scm>
        <url>https://github.com/wireapp/lithium</url>
    </scm>

    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
        <repository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url>
        </repository>
    </distributionManagement>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>11</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>11</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>
        <maven.test.skip>true</maven.test.skip>
    </properties>

    <repositories>
        <!-- to fetch specific version of dropwizard-swagger dependency -->
        <repository>
            <id>jitpack.io</id>
            <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
        </repository>
    </repositories>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
            <artifactId>xenon</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.1</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>slf4j-log4j12</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>log4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-core</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-jdbi3</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-client</artifactId>
            <version>4.0.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.github.smoketurner</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-swagger</artifactId>
            <version>72e8441e4a</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <version>42.5.3</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
            <!-- we need stick here so far as prod is running on older version of Postgres -->
            <!--suppress MavenPackageUpdate -->
            <version>7.8.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-testing</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.24.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <packaging>jar</packaging>
    <build>
        <finalName>lithium</finalName>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.6.13</version>
                <extensions>true</extensions>
                <configuration>
                    <serverId>ossrh</serverId>
                    <nexusUrl>https://oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl>
                    <autoReleaseAfterClose>true</autoReleaseAfterClose>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.1</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-sources</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Prevent gpg from using pinentry programs -->
                    <gpgArguments>
                        <arg>--pinentry-mode</arg>
                        <arg>loopback</arg>
                    </gpgArguments>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                        <phase>verify</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>sign</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <!-- running the JUnit 5 tests -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.0-M9</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
    <artifactId>lithium</artifactId>
    <version>3.5.1</version>
    <name>Lithium</name>
    <description>Wire Bots SDK written in Java</description>
    <url>https://wire.com/</url>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>GNU General Public License v3.0</name>
            <url>https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>

    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>Dejan Kovacevic</name>
            <email>dejan@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
        <developer>
            <name>Lukas Forst</name>
            <email>lukas@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
    </developers>

    <scm>
        <url>https://github.com/wireapp/lithium</url>
    </scm>

    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
        <repository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url>
        </repository>
    </distributionManagement>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>11</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>11</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>
        <maven.test.skip>true</maven.test.skip>
    </properties>

    <repositories>
        <!-- to fetch specific version of dropwizard-swagger dependency -->
        <repository>
            <id>jitpack.io</id>
            <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
        </repository>
    </repositories>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
            <artifactId>xenon</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.1</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>slf4j-log4j12</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>log4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-core</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-jdbi3</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-client</artifactId>
            <version>4.0.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.github.smoketurner</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-swagger</artifactId>
            <version>72e8441e4a</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <version>42.5.3</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
            <!-- we need stick here so far as prod is running on older version of Postgres -->
            <!--suppress MavenPackageUpdate -->
            <version>7.8.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-testing</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.24.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <packaging>jar</packaging>
    <build>
        <finalName>lithium</finalName>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.6.13</version>
                <extensions>true</extensions>
                <configuration>
                    <serverId>ossrh</serverId>
                    <nexusUrl>https://oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl>
                    <autoReleaseAfterClose>true</autoReleaseAfterClose>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.1</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-sources</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Prevent gpg from using pinentry programs -->
                    <gpgArguments>
                        <arg>--pinentry-mode</arg>
                        <arg>loopback</arg>
                    </gpgArguments>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                        <phase>verify</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>sign</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <!-- running the JUnit 5 tests -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.0-M9</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

steps.message: Now let me understand the issue better. The problem is that in Dropwizard 4.x, there were package changes. Dropwizard 4.x moved from `io.dropwizard` to `io.dropwizard.core` for the main packages. Let me check what imports are being used and what the correct packages should be:

I can see the issue now. The problem is that the project has:
- `dropwizard-core` version `2.1.5`
- `dropwizard-client` version `4.0.0`
- `dropwizard-jdbi3` version `2.1.5`
- `dropwizard-testing` version `2.1.5`

The versions are mismatched. In Dropwizard 4.x, the packages changed from `io.dropwizard` to `io.dropwizard.core` for the core module. The compilation error occurs because the code imports `io.dropwizard.setup.Environment` but `dropwizard-client:4.0.0` expects `io.dropwizard.core.setup.Environment`.

The simplest fix is to update ALL dropwizard dependencies to version 4.0.0 to have them consistent. Let me check if there are breaking changes I need to account for:
Let me read the affected files and understand what changes are needed:

Now I understand the full picture. The issue is that Dropwizard 4.x moved from `io.dropwizard` to `io.dropwizard.core` for the core packages. The best approach is to:

1. Update all dropwizard dependencies to version 4.0.0 in pom.xml
2. Update the imports in the source files to use the new package structure

Let me first check what changes are needed for Dropwizard 4.x imports. In Dropwizard 4.x:
- `io.dropwizard.setup.Environment` → `io.dropwizard.core.setup.Environment`
- `io.dropwizard.Application` → `io.dropwizard.core.Application`
- `io.dropwizard.Configuration` → `io.dropwizard.core.Configuration`
- etc.

Let me update the pom.xml to use version 4.0.0 for all dropwizard dependencies:

<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
    <artifactId>lithium</artifactId>
    <version>3.5.1</version>
    <name>Lithium</name>
    <description>Wire Bots SDK written in Java</description>
    <url>https://wire.com/</url>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>GNU General Public License v3.0</name>
            <url>https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>

    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>Dejan Kovacevic</name>
            <email>dejan@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
        <developer>
            <name>Lukas Forst</name>
            <email>lukas@wire.com</email>
            <organization>Wire Swiss GmbH</organization>
            <organizationUrl>https://wire.com</organizationUrl>
            <timezone>UTC+01:00</timezone>
        </developer>
    </developers>

    <scm>
        <url>https://github.com/wireapp/lithium</url>
    </scm>

    <distributionManagement>
        <snapshotRepository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>
        <repository>
            <id>ossrh</id>
            <url>https://oss.sonatype.org/service/local/staging/deploy/maven2/</url>
        </repository>
    </distributionManagement>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>11</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>11</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>
        <maven.test.skip>true</maven.test.skip>
    </properties>

    <repositories>
        <!-- to fetch specific version of dropwizard-swagger dependency -->
        <repository>
            <id>jitpack.io</id>
            <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
        </repository>
    </repositories>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.wire</groupId>
            <artifactId>xenon</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.1</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>slf4j-log4j12</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>log4j</groupId>
                    <artifactId>log4j</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-core</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-jdbi3</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-client</artifactId>
            <version>4.0.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.github.smoketurner</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-swagger</artifactId>
            <version>72e8441e4a</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <version>42.5.3</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
            <!-- we need stick here so far as prod is running on older version of Postgres -->
            <!--suppress MavenPackageUpdate -->
            <version>7.8.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.dropwizard</groupId>
            <artifactId>dropwizard-testing</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.5</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <version>3.24.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <packaging>jar</packaging>
    <build>
        <finalName>lithium</finalName>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.sonatype.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>nexus-staging-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.6.13</version>
                <extensions>true</extensions>
                <configuration>
                    <serverId>ossrh</serverId>
                    <nexusUrl>https://oss.sonatype.org/</nexusUrl>
                    <autoReleaseAfterClose>true</autoReleaseAfterClose>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.1</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-sources</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Prevent gpg from using pinentry programs -->
                    <gpgArguments>
                        <arg>--pinentry-mode</arg>
                        <arg>loopback</arg>
                    </gpgArguments>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                        <phase>verify</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>sign</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <!-- running the JUnit 5 tests -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.0.0-M9</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

steps.message:
I see the issue. The package structure in Dropwizard 4.x is different from what I expected. The packages are:
- `io.dropwizard.logging.*` instead of `io.dropwizard.core.logging.*`
- `io.dropwizard.servlets.*` instead of `io.dropwizard.core.servlets.*`

But there's also the issue with `javax.ws.rs` packages not existing - this is because Dropwizard 4.x migrated from Java EE (javax) to Jakarta EE. Let me check what the correct imports are for Dropwizard 4.x:
